title: Asynchronous JS & Promises
overview: Master the event loop, microtask queuing, and concurrency primitives in modern JavaScript runtimes.
Implement robust error recovery mechanisms and abortable fetch operations.

takeaways.title: AbortController Primitives
takeaways.desc: Cancel inflight requests to prevent memory leaks and race condition states.

takeaways.title: Parallel vs Sequential Flows
takeaways.desc: Use Promise.allSettled for resilient non-blocking multi-resource hydrations.
